overview.text: The RFP is issued by Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) to select Stand-Alone Health Insurance providers for a Corporate Agency Arrangement. The purpose of the RFP is to offer Health Insurance based products to customers of Indian Overseas Bank. IOB is a public sector bank headquartered in Chennai with 92.44% Government of India share capital as on 31.03.2026.

scope.text: The Scope involves providing Health Insurance based products to the Bank's customers as a Corporate Agent.
The services include support & services, technology support, manpower support, and claim settlement.
IOB already has corporate agency tie-ups with M/s Universal Sompo General Insurance Company Ltd and M/s SBI General Insurance Company Ltd.
IOB currently has tie-ups with M/s Niva Bupa Health Insurance and M/s HDFC Ergo only for renewal business.
Provide full range of health insurance products including individual and group policies through bank branches, outlets, internet banking, and mobile banking.
Offer sales, renewals, claims handling, customer complaint resolutions, MIS updates, training, IT support, and manpower assistance.
Provide real-time data sharing on policies issued, policy renewals, lapsed policies, and claims via the Bidder's portal using a specific User ID and password.
The successful bidder must provide operational support for sales, training, renewals, claim settlement, and grievance redressal.
Claims must be settled within timelines prescribed by IRDAI, subject to receipt of intimation and submission of documents.
The bidder must ensure renewal notices are issued well before policy expiry.
Redressal of grievances within IRDAI timelines is required, whether from the policyholder directly or via the Corporate Agent.
Customer data must be kept confidential and cannot be used for any purpose other than rendering services to policyholders and the Bank.
No part of services can be sub-contracted without prior written consent of the Bank.
The bidder must provide a minimum Claim Settlement Ratio of 90% during the last two financial years.
The bidder must have a minimum Solvency Ratio of 150%.
To offer Health Insurance based products to Customers of Indian Overseas Bank via a stand-alone health insurance provider/s corporate agency arrangement.

The tie-up between the selected Company and the Bank shall be for a minimum period of 3 years subject to termination, commencing from a date to be determined /advised after completion of the process of selection.

The bank acts as a facilitator between the customer and the insurer, while the insurer is responsible for settling claims and not raising disputes with the bank regarding claim settlements.
